scope: Evidence status only, no change to canonical training bank or learning release
goal: Prevent repeated source/ABC research after a documented content decision, without presenting legal edition or expert signoff as already complete

TECHNICAL_CONTENT.meaning: Agreement between original question, A/B/C, stored imported key, specific source and prior technical or legal reasoning. SOURCE_ABC_RECONCILED means documented evidence-level content conclusion, NOT an ANRE certified grade-specific exam answer or review by qualified human.

EXAM_BIBLIOGRAPHY.meaning: Exam-year-and-grade-specific ANRE official bibliography matched to exact source edition and amendments; proof must be named and checked. Law present on official portal alone does not establish exam-bibliography eligibility.

QUALIFIED_SIGNOFF.meaning: Real identified qualified professional with scope (law / technical / linguistic) and dated signed verdict, with independence/provenance; AI model review does not qualify.

invariants: Three fields are never merged into a generic boolean approved.
A qualified signoff cannot be inferred from AI review, internal checklist or a cited document.
Technical content source/ABC evidence is not reopened solely because bibliography or qualified signoff remains pending.

Reopen technical content only if new primary normative provision, a different applicable edition, exact grade condition, a counterexample, option uniqueness conflict, or a canonical-stem/key checksum mismatch is documented; log change reason and before/after.
Any substantive contradiction moves TECHNICAL_CONTENT to BLOCKED_CONTRADICTION and prevents learner-use approval.
Bibliography confirmation is a separate batch action; signoff is a separate batch action; avoid redoing A/B/C for either.
Release readiness, offline card integration, legal redistribution rights and user approval are product-level gates separate from question content.
No modifications to imported answer keys, original stem/ABC, HTML, APK, PR merge or release without explicit user approval.
formal_learner_gate: Eligible for consideration ONLY when technical content SOURCE_ABC_RECONCILED, bibliography VERIFIED_APPLICABLE_EDITIONS, qualified signoff SIGNED_BY_NAMED_QUALIFIED_REVIEWER, and relevant product QA/release controls passed; do not set learner approved based on 3 statuses alone.
